name: A Lack of Fear

meta.start: High Priest Rohan / High Priestess Laurena / Priestess Alathea

summary: In Ironforge, High Priest Rohan tests promising dwarven disciples. In the Mystic Ward, he teaches them as their strength of spirit grows.

sections.title: A Summons to Ironforge
sections.body: Local mentors send priests serving the Alliance abroad to senior clergy of their order. For dwarven disciples, that summons brings you to High Priest Rohan in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. There, basic spiritual practice gives way to deeper uses of holy magic, tested through trials.

sections.title: The Trials of Fortitude
sections.body: Dwarven tradition teaches that the Light is a shield in physical conflict. When you report to High Priest Rohan, you show that you have endured trials in the wider world. Now you must prove your mettle and master fear on the front lines.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: why do i have to go to rohan
what does a lack of fear do
faq.answer: Local priest trainers send seasoned initiates to High Priest Rohan in Ironforge for advanced instruction and the spiritual gifts taught by the city's priesthood.
High Priest Rohan leads the dwarven priesthood in Ironforge. In the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward, he teaches disciples steadfast devotion and martial resilience.

faq.q: Where can High Priest Rohan be found?
aliases: how to find high priest rohan
faq.answer: High Priest Rohan can be found in the Hall of Mysteries, in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge's western quarters.

faq.q: Why is this called 'A Lack of Fear'?
faq.answer: The name points to Fear Ward, the Holy Light's protection against panic and supernatural terror. Every priest, of any race, learns it from a priest trainer at level 20.

faq.q: Who sends the priest to Ironforge?
aliases: who starts a lack of fear
quest givers for lack of fear
faq.answer: Local trainers send initiates to Ironforge. High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind and Priestess Alathea in Darnassus direct students to honor their heritage or study with Rohan.

aliases: is there combat in a lack of fear
faq.answer: No. You travel to Ironforge and speak with High Priest Rohan.

angles.text: As a priest, this summons marks your coming of age in the priesthood. You can learn holy techniques refined by Ironforge's stalwart clergy.
As a dwarf, returning to Rohan honors your people's faith, physical fortitude, and martial grit in service to the Holy Light.
As an Alliance priest, you study alongside clergy from other capitals. Alliance priesthoods send acolytes across borders to learn from masters in Ironforge.
